panel.title: Admin panel
panel.sectionsIntro: Turn site sections on or off for non-admin users. You still see everything (unless you enable "View as user"). Changes are reflected in real time for all connected clients.

pushTest.title: Test push notifications
pushTest.intro: Send yourself a test push to all your subscribed devices (this one and any other where you enabled notifications). It's useful to verify that delivery to the operating system works, without waiting for a real event.
pushTest.activateHint: (or from your profile) so the test reaches this screen.
pushTest.sentOne: Sent to 1 device. Check that the notification arrives.
pushTest.sentMany: Sent to {{count}} devices. Check that the notification arrives.
pushTest.noDevicesMessage: You don't have any device with push enabled. Enable it and try again.
pushTest.errorSend: We couldn't send the test push.
